title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate the diffusion and persistence of mask-wearing behavior in a population, influenced by social networks, policies, information exposure, and supply/price constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Peer influence within social networks alters individuals' perceived norms and adoption thresholds.

interactions.name: policy_compliance_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement at locations influence compliance and perceived costs/benefits of mask use.

interactions.name: information_exposure
interactions.description: Media and government campaigns affect risk perception, beliefs, and trust, shifting adoption probabilities.

interactions.name: mask_purchase_and_supply
interactions.description: Agents attempt to purchase masks; availability, price, and rationing determine access.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: Agents move through locations (home, work, community), creating opportunities for social influence and policy enforcement.

interactions.name: risk_feedback
interactions.description: External or endogenous risk signals (e.g., prevalence) update agents' risk perception, affecting adoption.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of population wearing masks at each time step and cumulatively.

metrics.name: adoption_by_context
metrics.description: Mask usage rates by location type (home, work, community).

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days to reach specified adoption levels (e.g., 50%, 70%, 90%).

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to mandates/enforcement (e.g., difference-in-differences versus counterfactual).

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Variance or Gini of adoption rates across demographic or income groups.

metrics.name: supply_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days with mask stockouts or unmet demand.

metrics.name: information_impact
metrics.description: Elasticity of adoption with respect to campaign intensity or misinformation rate.
